_note: Which PartShape class an LDraw category reads as. `keywords` overrides the default when the subcategory contains one as a substring, in the order listed -- first match wins, so a keyword meant to exclude a false positive on a later one (Technic's `Cross Block`, Brick/Tile's `Corner`) is listed first. A keyword's value can itself be `null` (no shape at all, e.g. Cross Block) rather than a class name. A row naming no `default` (Technic) yields no shape at all outside its keywords -- most of what LDraw calls Technic (a gear's tooth count, a connector's part number) is not a length. A keyword naming Disc or Rod that only partially matches the subcategory (`Round` inside `Round Half Circle`) is not rejected here: derivation.py's _classify flags it 'qualified', and _measured_reading confirms or clears it against the part's own measured footprint -- name and geometry together, since neither alone tells a partial round shape ('Round Half Circle', 'Rounded') from a fully round one with a descriptive qualifier ('Round Sphere', 'Round Reinforced'). Cone/Dish/Turntable are round by category rather than by keyword, so that check never applies to them; a qualifier that disqualifies a category-default round reading (Cone's `Half`) needs its own keyword row instead, the same as any other exclusion.
